title: Paper Lanterns
entry_order: 같은 음 8마디 → 조용한 베이스 → 얇은 리드 오르간 화음 → 첫 훅 → 드럼
instruments: 8비트 펄스 건반 + 얇은 리드 오르간 + 둥근 베이스
style: First eight bars: one soft 8-bit keyboard repeats ONE SINGLE PITCH with identical duration and level, slow even strikes separated by silence; no chords or accompaniment. Keep this pulse under quiet bass, then thin reed-organ chords; only afterward introduce a tiny two-note hook. Bittersweet electronica, 122 BPM, 4/4 in F major, around 3:40. Target harmony F - Am - Bb - Bbm, two bars per chord, entering after the bare opening. Dry sampled big-beat drums arrive late. Keep the chip hook sparse and unchanged as organ voicings widen. Tender sadness with a small warm lift. Briefly return to the bare pulse, then bring back the same hook over fuller drums and organ. Grow through layers and force, never faster notes or extra lead phrases. Instrumental.

title: Blue Current
entry_order: 고무 같은 베이스 4마디 → 드럼 → 짧은 게임 건반 훅 → 기타 화음
instruments: 부드러운 펄스 건반 + 고무 같은 모노 베이스 + 트레몰로 기타 화음
style: Instrumental buoyant breakbeat electronica, 126 BPM, 4/4 in D minor, around 3:30. Begin with four bars of rubbery mono bass playing a plain two-note rhythm; add chopped live break drums and a light ride, then a soft pulse-keyboard hook, with tremolo guitar holding quiet chords later. Target Dm - G - C, held for two, one and one bars; the G chord gives a hopeful Dorian color. The game-like lead uses just two short pitches with space, repeating the same figure throughout. Guitar supports harmony without a second melody. Bright forward motion with a wistful edge. In the middle remove guitar and keyboard for a short bass-and-drums passage, then return the identical hook in warmer harmony. Change weight and space rather than adding runs; finish with a clean compact stop.

title: Pocket Sunrise
entry_order: 하이햇·림 2마디 → 사각파 훅 → 베이스 → 리본처럼 얇은 화음
instruments: 사각파 리드 + 짧은 서브 베이스 + 얇은 폴리 신스 화음
style: Instrumental bright chip breakbeat, 124 BPM, 4/4 in B major, around 3:20. Open with two bars of light hats and dry rim clicks, then a crisp square-wave hook; a short sub bass and thin poly-synth chords join separately. Target B - D# - G#m, two bars on B and one on each following chord. Keep the main hook to two evenly spaced pitches with a rest, exactly the same simple rhythm on each return. Springy two-step drums give lift without frantic lead playing. Warm, sunny and lightly nostalgic rather than deeply sad. Chords open in the refrain; a two-bar stop leaves only the tiny hook before the groove returns. Keep the same game-console lead at the final brighter refrain; no answering arpeggio or extra lead. Use rhythmic gaps and wider harmony for growth, then resolve quietly.

title: After the Rain
entry_order: 같은 음 8마디 → 사인 베이스 → 낮은 펠트 피아노 화음 → 첫 훅 → 드럼
instruments: 얇은 삼각파 건반 + 펠트 피아노 화음 + 사인 베이스
drums: 느낌이 넓은 다운비트 빅비트·마른 킥/낮은 스네어
style: First eight bars: a soft thin digital keyboard strikes ONE SINGLE PITCH slowly and evenly, same duration and level with silence between; no harmony or accompaniment. A quiet sine bass enters, then low felt-piano chords, and only then a small sorrowful two-note hook. Instrumental electronica, 120 BPM, 4/4 in G minor, around 4:10. Target Gm - Cm - Eb - D, one bar per chord after the opening. Add weighty downtempo-feel big-beat drums later, with a dry kick and low snare at the full 120 BPM pulse. The simple triangle-like game lead stays exposed as piano harmony warms around it. Withdraw to uneasy low bass before the same unchanged hook returns in broad instrumental harmony. Patient, fragile and deeply wistful; increase force and width, never the hook's note count or ornamentation.

title: Open Roads
entry_order: 피크 베이스 2마디 → 라이브 드럼 → 디지털 건반 훅 → 기타 스탭
instruments: 디지털 태인 건반 + 피크 일렉 베이스 + 짧은 클린 기타 화음
drums: 빠르고 선명한 라이브 록 브레이크·열린 하이햇
style: Instrumental electronic breakbeat rock, 128 BPM, 4/4 in C major, around 3:25. Picked electric bass opens alone for two bars with one short repeated rhythm; crisp live drums with open hats enter before a soft digital-tine keyboard hook. Clean guitar adds only clipped chord stabs. Target C - F - Dm - G, one bar per chord. The warm game-like keyboard is the sole melodic lead: just three slow notes, a rest and the same small shape every time. Energetic, clear and openhearted with a trace of longing. Keep the drums at full speed when the middle strips down to bass, then return guitar and the identical hook. Broaden chord voicings for the last refrain without new lead notes, guitar solos or counterlines. Tight low end, tactile drums, clean resolved outro.

title: Faded Polaroid
entry_order: 두 음 느린 교대 4마디 → 낮은 베이스 → 따뜻한 신스 화음 → 드럼
instruments: 속 빈 디지털 건반 + 뮤트 신스 베이스 + 따뜻한 아날로그 화음
drums: 게이트 리버브 스네어가 있는 느슨한 전자 브레이크
style: Instrumental wistful digital electronica, 123 BPM, 4/4 in F# minor, around 3:50. Start with four bare bars of two soft keyboard notes alternating slowly, with long spaces and no chords, bass or drums. Add a muted synth bass, then warm analog chord beds; loose electronic break drums with a short gated snare arrive later. Target F#m - D - A - E, two bars per chord once harmony begins. Let the initial two-note figure become the whole hook; keep its pitches and sparse rhythm unchanged. Hollow 8-bit tones gain a warmer 16-bit body without more melodic detail. Withdraw one layer at a time in the middle, briefly exposing the original pair of notes. The same figure returns over fuller chords and drums. Sad but gently luminous; let repetition and texture carry emotion rather than decorative runs.

title: Warm Pixels
entry_order: 킥·짧은 스네어 2마디 → 짧은 칩 훅 → 탄성 베이스 → 클라비 화음
instruments: 둥근 펄스 리드 + 탄성 베이스 + 짧은 클라비 화음
style: Instrumental warm chip-soul electronica, 125 BPM, 4/4 in Eb major, around 3:35. Begin with two bars of dry shuffled kick and short snare, then a round pulse-wave hook, elastic bass and quiet clavinet chords entering one at a time. Target Eb - Gm - Cm - Fm, one bar per chord in a soft continuous cycle. Keep the game-like hook to two plain notes and a rest; no response melody. Sunny rhythm with a tender melancholy undercurrent. Clavinet plays sparse chord touches, not a busy riff. At the middle thin the groove to bass and light percussion, then restore the exact hook as warmer 16-bit-like harmonies widen. Keep the rhythmic swing gentle and the lead simple at the peak. A small final chord release closes the track; growth comes from chord color and drum weight, not extra notes.

title: Still a Spark
entry_order: 같은 음 8마디 → 부드러운 사각 베이스 → 전기피아노 화음 → 첫 훅 → 드럼
instruments: 가느다란 8비트 건반 + 전기피아노 화음 + 부드러운 사각 베이스
style: First eight bars: a thin soft digital keyboard repeats ONE SINGLE PITCH, same duration and level at slow even intervals, with silence and no accompaniment. Keep that pulse as a soft square bass enters, then sustained electric-piano chords; only afterward let a tiny two-note hook emerge. Instrumental hopeful electronica, 121 BPM, 4/4 in A major, around four minutes. Target A - G - D - A, one bar per chord after the solo opening. Sparse low-tom big-beat drums join late. The plain 8-bit lead stays central while electric-piano voicings add warm 16-bit-like depth. More reassuring than tragic, with a faint ache. A middle withdrawal leaves the original pulse and muted kick; the same hook then returns in gently broader harmony. Keep melody and bass figures very simple; no ornamental expansion or festival climax.

title: Glass Horizon
entry_order: 오래 누른 두 화음 4마디 → 끊는 드럼 → 두 음 칩 훅 → 서브
instruments: 연한 사각파 건반 + 얇은 현악 화음 + 짧은 서브 베이스
style: Instrumental tense but luminous chip electronica, 127 BPM, 4/4 in C minor, around 3:30. Open with four bars of thin held string chords moving slowly between Cm and Db; there is no lead melody yet. Tight break drums with a metallic rim enter, then a soft square-keyboard hook and short sub bass. Target a two-chord Cm - Db vamp, two bars per chord; the borrowed Db adds a dark edge without fast harmonic changes. Use only two spaced hook notes in the same plain rhythm throughout. Strings hold harmony without runs or a second melody. The beat moves eagerly while the lead stays quietly aching. Remove the sub for a floating middle, then return its weight under the identical game-like hook and wider strings. End with a reduced repeat of the hook rather than a new theme.

title: Half Past Home
entry_order: 플럭 베이스·킥 4마디 → 태인 건반 훅 → 기타 뮤트 화음 → 스네어
instruments: 디지털 태인 건반 + 플럭 베이스 + 뮤트 리듬 기타
drums: 뒤로 살짝 눕는 브로큰 비트·부드러운 사이드스틱
style: Instrumental warm broken-beat electronica, 124 BPM, 4/4 in F major, around 3:40. Open with four bars of plucked bass and a dry kick, repeating a tiny two-note bass pattern. Bring in a soft digital-tine keyboard hook, then muted rhythm-guitar chords, with gentle sidestick snare joining last. Target Dm - Gm - Bb - F, one bar per chord. Keep the keyboard hook to three slow notes and a rest, unchanged all the way through; bass stays equally plain. Warmly hopeful with a little homesick sadness, carried by a laid-back broken beat at full tempo. Guitar is rhythmic harmony, never an extra lead. Strip the bridge to bass and side clicks, then return the same lightly game-like hook over wider chords. Build warmth and drum weight without arpeggios or new melodic phrases; end on a soft stable F chord.

title: Small Satellites
entry_order: 같은 음 8마디 → 부드러운 저음 → 얇은 현악 화음 → 첫 훅 → 드럼
instruments: 유리 같은 FM 건반 + 짧은 저음 + 얇은 현악 신스
style: First eight bars: one soft glassy FM keyboard repeats ONE SINGLE PITCH with identical duration and level, slow even strikes with silence; no melody, chords or accompaniment. Add quiet low bass, then a thin held string-synth chord before the first small two-note hook. Instrumental chip electronica, 126 BPM, 4/4 in B minor, around 4:05. Target a slow Bm - Em vamp, four bars per chord after the opening. Tight machine big-beat drums with a short clap-like snare arrive late. Keep the same 8-bit/16-bit keyboard voice and plain hook throughout, while string voicings grow warmer and drums gain force. Sorrowful but quietly determined. A short middle clears back to the exposed hook and silence; its exact return over full harmony provides the peak. No added lead notes or busy bass variations.

title: Sunday Voltage
entry_order: 건반·베이스의 짧은 같은 리듬 → 드럼 → 바리톤 기타 화음
instruments: 8비트 느낌 태인 건반 + 둥근 일렉 베이스 + 바리톤 기타 스탭
style: Instrumental exuberant electronic breakbeat rock, 128 BPM, 4/4 in G major, around 3:20. Begin immediately with a soft 8-bit-like tine keyboard and round electric bass playing the same tiny two-note rhythm in unison. Compressed live break drums enter after two bars, with brief tom pickups; baritone guitar supplies clipped chord stabs later. Target G - Am - C - Eb, one bar per chord; the borrowed Eb gives the bright groove a fleeting wistful turn. Keep the lead's two pitches and rests fixed, without embellishment. Guitar and bass never add competing lines. A short stop exposes the tiny original figure before the full-speed beat returns. Make the last refrain wider and stronger through chords and drums, not melodic complexity. Playful energy, warm nostalgia, firm clean ending.

title: Tides in Reverse
entry_order: 스윙 하이햇 2마디 → 두 음 베이스 → 얇은 칩 훅 → 오르간 화음
instruments: 부드러운 펄스 건반 + 사인 베이스 + 조용한 오르간 화음
style: Instrumental melancholic shuffle-break electronica, 122 BPM, 4/4 in D minor, around 4:15. Two bars of soft swung hats open alone; then a sine bass repeats just two low notes before the thin pulse-keyboard hook enters. Quiet organ chords and a brushed snare over chopped kick arrive separately. Target Dm - Am - Bb - Gm, two bars per chord. Keep the game-like keyboard hook to two long notes and a rest; preserve this plain figure through every build. Deeply wistful with a gentle forward dance pulse. Organ holds simple harmony and never answers with another melody. In the middle leave bass and hats for a few bars, then let the identical hook return over warmer instrumental chords. Grow drum weight and stereo width patiently, keeping bass and lead sparse even at the peak; finish with the opening hats fading.

title: Keep the Window Open
entry_order: 두 음 디지털 훅 즉시 → 4마디 뒤 베이스 → 드럼 → 긴 기타 화음
instruments: 둥근 디지털 건반 + 부드러운 저음 + 길게 울리는 클린 기타 화음
drums: 직선적인 킥과 넓은 어쿠스틱 스네어의 하이브리드 빅비트
style: Instrumental bright yet aching digital electronica, 125 BPM, 4/4 in E major, around four minutes. Start with the main hook immediately: just two soft keyboard notes and a long rest, played alone for four bars. Rounded bass follows, then a straight hybrid big beat with wide acoustic snare; clean guitar joins as long held chords. Target E - A - Am - E, two bars per chord after the bare opening. The plain 8-bit/16-bit keyboard remains the only lead throughout. Guitar adds harmonic width without a riff or countermelody. Keep the same tiny hook unchanged as the beat becomes exhilarating and the minor-color chord adds longing. A brief middle break leaves the keyboard and guitar, then all layers return for one warm final refrain. Fullness comes from chord voicing and rhythmic force, never more melody notes. End with the hook alone.
